exposure: history of peripartum Takotsubo syndrome (TTS) complicated by cardiogenic shock
outcome: patient and newborn discharged in good health
monitoring left ventricular systolic function and hemodynamic conditions
cohort: A 39-year-old female with a history of peripartum TTS complicated by cardiogenic shock who became pregnant again.
finding: Close cardiological follow-up, appropriate management therapy, and anesthesia modality allowed for the safe management of a new pregnancy in a patient with a history of complicated peripartum TTS.
mod_finding: Epidural anesthesia was preferred during cesarean delivery to avoid catecholamine surge, contributing to a safe outcome.
followup_time: a few days postpartum for discharge
